t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Orange, green, red and blue take you to the red basket (bright forest) & the other gnome hats take you to the dark forest.The mushroom total from each forest changes over time & all other information (position, size etc is irrelevant, in terms of harvest).

vb_textbox.text: Hello! I have just completed the mushroom task and have some (hopefully) useful advice to help you quickly adopt a successful strategy (which will maximise your yield of mushrooms).Everything in the game is irrelevant, except for the colour of the gnomes hat! This is the only factor that affects which forest you visit, and thus how many mushrooms you harvest.Orange, green, red and blue hats take you to the forest with the red basket. Brown, yellow, pink and purple take you to the yellow basket.If a forest is yielding well (~5-9 mushrooms), this is worth sticking with. Once the yield drops below, it is worth switching and selecting the hat colour that corresponds to the other forest.Good luck.
